content: MSAL Python 1.39.0 (PyPI 2026-09-17). ConfidentialClientApplication.initiate_auth_code_flow + acquire_token_by_auth_code_flow generate PKCE code_verifier/S256 challenge, state and nonce automatically. SerializableTokenCache.serialize()/deserialize() return a JSON string and expose has_state_changed; no built-in persistence and no encryption. http_cache is optional in-memory metadata with no tokens or PII; do not persist it.
